description: Sandbox only with a merchant key: send money from the merchant balance to a Wave or Orange Money number. In production, agents pay out only through an agent wallet key (ak_) with limits set by a human.

amount.description: Amount the recipient receives, in whole XOF (F CFA). Integer, no decimals: 5000 = 5 000 F CFA.

idempotency_key.description: Stable key for this business action (e.g. order-1042). Reuse the SAME key when retrying; a new key creates a new operation.

name: xaalis_create_payout
title: Pay out to a wallet (sandbox)
